$\blueD{75\%}$ $\greenD{\text{of}}$ $\maroonD{96}$ is the same as $\blueD{75\%}\greenD{\times}\maroonD{96}$.

To solve $\blueD{75\%}\greenD{\times}\maroonD{96}$, we need to convert $\blueD{75\%}$ to either a decimal or a fraction.

Percent means per hundred, so $\blueD{75\%}$ is equivalent to $\blueD{\dfrac{75}{100}}$ which is also equal to $\blueD{75\div 100=0.75}$.

 $\blueD{75\%= \dfrac{75}{100} = 0.75}$

$\begin{align}\blueD{75\%}\ \text{of}\ \maroonD{96}&=\blueD{\dfrac{75}{100}}\cdot\maroonD{96}\\\\
&=\blueD{0.75}\cdot\maroonD{96}\\\\
&=72
\end{align}$

Are any of the other choices equivalent?

The fractions $\dfrac{75}{100}$ and $\dfrac{3}{4}$ are equivalent. So:

$\blueD{\dfrac{75}{100}}\cdot\maroonD{96}=\blueD{\dfrac{3}{4}}\cdot\maroonD{96}$

The expression $\blueD{\dfrac{3}{4}}\cdot\maroonD{96}$ is equivalent to $75\%$ of $96$.

$\dfrac{4}{3}\cdot 96=128$

The expression $\dfrac{4}{3}\cdot 96$ is **not** equivalent to $75\%$ of $96$.

$75\cdot 96=7{,}200$

The expression $75\cdot 96$ is **not** equivalent to $75\%$ of $96$.

The options that have the same value as $75\%$ of $96$ are:

- $\dfrac{75}{100}\cdot 96$
- $0.75\cdot 96$
- $\dfrac{3}{4}\cdot 96$
